purpose: Research inventory to compare against repository; not a claim these assets are absent or complete.
methodology: Primary official GLITCH episode pages and Netflix verify release boundary.
Detailed appearance discovery uses TADC Fandom indexes; direct page fetch returned 402, indexed search content was readable.
Production tiers and suggested game roles are project design decisions, not official show classifications.
No episode frame was inspected by this research task; fidelity must be approved with source frames before marking a sprite final.
Official merchandise confirms many names but collectible proportions are not a substitute for screen model references.
Repeated normal costumes and props are not additional characters. Source-evidence and repository-completion statuses are separate.
